name: Spark Tray
tagline: Spark Tray is a versatile Windows utility belt designed to streamline media management and productivity tasks directly on your machine
description: Spark Tray is a versatile Windows utility belt designed to streamline media management and productivity tasks directly on your machine. This local application allows users to download video and audio, process bulk-queue lists, and remove image backgrounds without relying on cloud-based services. By keeping operations local, it ensures a faster workflow for common digital tasks.
